layers: Presentation (Accessible Minimalist Views with 48dp targets & LiveRegions)
architecture.a11y_strategy: WCAG 2.2 AAA & TalkBack/Jieshuo Optimized: High contrast dark theme, explicit Arabic labels, zero silent buttons, audio-focus ducking, live audio progress regions
architecture.persistence: EncryptedSharedPreferences (API Key) & Android Internal Storage (Audio Cache)

requirements.title: Smart Markdown & Text Ingestion and Chunking
requirements.description: Parse .md and .txt books, extract chapters via headers, strip markdown noise while injecting vocal pause tags, and chunk at sentence boundaries (<8000 chars).
requirements.verification_criteria: Chunk sizes strictly <= 8000 chars, zero split words, and headers converted to chapters with vocal pauses.

requirements.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS Integration
requirements.description: Connect to Google Gemini API (gemini-3.8-flash-tts) using BYOK, sending clean text in input and style instructions in speech_metadata, decoding Base64 audio.
requirements.verification_criteria: Valid API request payload sent, Base64 audio decoded and saved as playable audio.

requirements.title: Accessible Media Player Engine
requirements.description: Background audio playback using Media3 ExoPlayer with lock screen notification, earphone button control, audio-focus ducking for TalkBack, and auto-bookmarking.
requirements.verification_criteria: Background playback continues when screen is off, audio ducks when screen reader speaks, and progress persists across app restarts.

requirements.title: Ultra-Minimalist Accessible User Interface
requirements.description: Clean, uncluttered screen-reader optimized UI with single-tap playback, long-press actions, mini-player bar, and zero visual clutter.
requirements.verification_criteria: All touch targets >= 48dp, 100% elements have Arabic contentDescription, zero silent elements, linear focus order.

requirements.title: Environment Self-Check & CLI Verification Tool
requirements.description: Expose a --doctor test runner to verify environment, API connectivity, audio decoding, and file processing directly in Termux/Android.
requirements.verification_criteria: --doctor command returns 0 on healthy environment with diagnostic feedback.
